results.snippet: When CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER (3) is enabled, and the verification fails to prove that the certificate is signed by a CA, the connection fails. When this option is disabled (set to zero), the CA certificates are not loaded and the peer certificate verification is simply skipped.
